headquarters: HITEC City, Cyberabad, Hyderabad, Telangana, India
regulatory_framework: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) & NPCI Guidelines
deposit_insurance: DICGC Insured up to ₹5,00,000 per depositor
compliance_rules: NEVER request or log customer UPI PIN, ATM PIN, full 16-digit card number, CVV, or Aadhaar OTP.
RBI 2017 Zero Liability Charter: Unauthorized electronic transactions reported within 3 days carry zero liability for the customer.
Inward SWIFT transfers over $2,500 USD require electronic FIRC Purpose Code declaration under FEMA.
NPCI UPI Auto-reversal Rule: Failed UPI debits must be auto-credited back to payer within T+1 working day or attract ₹100/day penalty.
Courtesy fee waivers are restricted to 1 waiver per rolling 12 months for retail customers; MSME waivers require Branch Manager approval.

policies.rule: Retail and Student savings accounts are eligible for ONE courtesy fee/AMC reversal every 12 months if account maintains clean standing. MSME accounts require Regional Branch Manager sign-off if a waiver was already given within 180 days.

Foreign Inward Remittance Certificates (FIRC) are generated automatically for pre-verified corporate and personal software/consulting purpose codes (e.g. P0802). Holds are released within 15 minutes of electronic declaration.

RuPay and Mastercard cards can be frozen or unfrozen instantly via conversational banking or mobile app. Freezing blocks new POS, ATM, and e-commerce transactions while pre-authorized UPI AutoPay remains intact.
Customers can dispute failed UPI transactions, duplicate debits, or unauthorized charges. Provisional credit is credited within 24 hours for Premier clients and within 48 hours for standard accounts.
Weekend QR Soundbox collections are aggregated and settled automatically via NPCI merchant clearing on Monday morning at 06:00 IST.
Savings interest is 4.00% p.a. calculated daily. Fixed Deposit rates range from 6.75% (1 yr) to 7.65% (3 yr Tax-Saver) for general public, with an additional +0.50% p.a. for Senior Citizens.
